•

•

•

•

•

• 
Assemble and weld components on a welding table without a pre-prepared jig.

Assess the quality of welded components and measure them accurately.

 
• 
Experience in welding steel, stainless steel and aluminium is essential.

Reading and interpreting technical drawings comes naturally to you.

A day-shift position suits your expectations.

In 1932, Belgian baker Jan Boone created a caramelised biscuit made only from natural ingredients. He named it Lotus, after the flower that symbolises purity. In the 1950s, Boone began wrapping his Speculoos individually and introduced them to cafés and restaurants as “the biscuit to enjoy with your coffee”. The idea was an instant hit, because coffee and Lotus Speculoos are made for each other: each one brings out the best in the other’s flavour, and together they form the perfect duo. Over the years, the popularity of Lotus Speculoos grew enormously, far beyond Belgium’s borders. From a caffè latte to an espresso to go, coffee lovers all over the world ask for a Lotus. Internationally, the biscuit is known as Lotus Biscoff, a contraction of “biscuit with coffee”. Today, Speculoos is much more than a biscuit to go with your coffee. Creative chefs also use it as an ingredient in delicious desserts such as tiramisu and speculoos mousse.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a world-famous Belgian cookie producer, is looking for a Maintenance Technician to join its technical team in Lembeke (East Flanders). You will help keep its large baking and packing lines running, in a growing company with a long history.

What you will do

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on the baking and packing lines
• Plan and execute major maintenance stops together with the technical team

• Find and solve mechanical and electrical problems

Your profile

• Strong mechanical skills (about 70%) and good electrical knowledge (about 30%)
• A technical diploma is a plus, but solid hands-on experience counts just as much
• Driven, reliable and proactive, able to work both independently and in a team
• Good English; Dutch is not required
• Valid Belgian work permit

Company Activities:

jobs.occupation: Budget Analyst at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Embassy in Brussels is looking for a Budget Analyst to join the Federal Aviation Administration.

Jobomschrijving

The job holder maintains budgets for all FAA lines of business in Brussels and FAA Representative offices located in Paris, Abu Dhabi, Dakar, Warsaw, and London. The budget management function includes expenditure forecasting, multi-year budget estimation, yearly travel budget development, expenditure tracking including travel burn rates, budget reconciliation, approval of payments, and submission of quarterly and close-out reports.

EDUCATION (multiple options): 2 years of University studies in any field or university degree in finance, accounting, business administration

EXPERIENCE: 2-5 years in finance, accounting, or business administration.

LANGUAGE: Fluency in English, French and Dutch.

Responsibilities

• Analyze and define security requirements to support organizational projects.
• Configure, support, and maintain security tools to ensure continuous protection.
• Manage identity components, user accounts, and complex provisioning processes.
• Implement and maintain advanced access management components and infrastructure.
• Monitor security systems to improve observability and defend against unauthorized access.
• Provide expert technical advice on OAuth and OpenID Connect protocols.

Requirements

• 8+ years of experience in security engineering or a similar technical capacity.
• 5+ years in Security and identity focusing on IAM, Active Directory, and Open LDAP.
• 5+ years of experience with OAuth and OpenID Connect authentication protocols.
• 3+ years working within SSDLC, RUP, and Agile methodologies.
• You possess practical scripting knowledge in Linux and Windows environments.
• You bring a solid understanding of application firewalls and web services security.
• You're proactive, solution-oriented, and a clear communicator.
• You are fluent in English and either Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Previous professional experience in network security.
• Knowledge of web services within Auth0.
• Familiarity with Okta or SailPoint.

jobs.occupation: ICT Talents - ERP Consultant (Oracle Fusion Cloud)
jobs.description:
For an international trading and distribution organisation, we are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion ERP Consultant to technically optimise the existing ERP environment and improve the efficiency of Finance and Operations.

Since the migration to Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, many processes are still handled manually, with a lack of reporting and visibility. Your mission? To implement concrete improvements, reduce repetitive tasks and provide the business with the insights and tools it needs.
Job description

As an ERP Consultant, you will work closely with the heads of Finance and Operations. You will analyse existing processes, identify quick wins and translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
Your responsibilities

• Reporting: Developing reports, dashboards, views and worklists, potentially in combination with Power BI.

• Automation: Implementing bulk uploads, streamlining transaction processing and reducing manual tasks.

• ERP optimisation: Analysing and improving existing processes within the ERP environment, with a focus on order-to-cash and procure-to-pay.

• Integrations: Optimising data flows and connections with external systems, such as EDI and Excel-based processes.

• Stakeholder management: Coordinating with Finance, Operations and the international IT team, while critically assessing and challenging potential solutions.

• Knowledge transfer: Documenting the implemented solutions to ensure the internal team can maintain them independently after the project.

We are looking for a technically strong, analytical and hands-on consultant who can quickly identify opportunities and deliver pragmatic solutions.

You have:

• Relevant experience with ERP implementations

• Experience with reporting, dashboards, views and worklists

• Good knowledge of Power BI and experience with EDI integrations

• Knowledge of bulk uploads, mass transactions and ERP process optimisation

• An understanding of order-to-cash and procure-to-pay processes

• Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is a strong asset, but not an absolute requirement

• A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to work within existing system limitations

• Strong communication skills and a good command of English

• Knowledge of Dutch is not required, but is considered a strong asset

• Experience with Azure DevOps is a plus

As a Corporate Communications department, we are in touch with colleagues from the divisions in the Benelux as well as with colleagues from the Headquarter in Germany, and external partners.

You have excellent communication skills and you are able to work in a team. Furthermore you are well-organized and able to work independently.

Working Hours
 
 

• Monday to Friday

Below is an example of the shift schedule, providing a clear understanding of the work hours and rotation you can expect in this role:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift (06:15 – 14:15) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift (21:45 – 06:30) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift (14:00 – 22:00) from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h - (06:30 – 18:30)  

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday, you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift (14:00 – 22:00).

We guarantee that you won’t be bored
 

As a process operator, you have several responsibilities:

Who are we looking for?
 

Well, an enthusiastic personality and a passion for technology already go a long way. You are hands-on, full of expectation and eager to prove yourself. You enjoy working in a team, are accurate, dare to take initiative and are not afraid of asking questions. You have fluent communication skills in English. You are not looking for a typical nine-to-five and you see the advantages of working in shifts every now and again — handsome bonusses and lots of quality time on your hands while others are ‘insanely busy’. An example of our shift regime:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h. 

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift. 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift.

Jobomschrijving
